newsitem.title: USA: Summit Design completes TriQuest buy.
newsitem.headline: Summit Design completes TriQuest buy.

text.p: Summit Design Inc said Monday it completed the acquisition of TriQuest Design Automation, a private engineering software company based in Campbell, California.
Summit, a supplier of engineering software products for the creation of electronic systems and integrated circuits, said it bought TriQuest for 775,000 shares of Summit common stock.
TriQuest develops hardware description language analysis and optimization tools for the design of high performance, deep submicron integrated circuits.
